notes.title: Unveiling Alpha 16 - A World of Thrilling New Adventures in RTE Worlds!

Here's a glimpse of what awaits you:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42049503/71da3f46dec5055d566185513ad757d4728b1315.jpg[/img]
[b]New Locations: [/b]Explore Captain Pike, Babylon, and the exclusive Founder/Backer Shrine, along with 15 new Points of Interest (POIs) that promise unique challenges and rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42049503/4a4e9badd9ca112c49101fd8d595e53589713f62.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42049503/9024b89b90a6ffe718fffdd2a959e6ac877bd543.jpg[/img]

notes.title: RTE Worlds Evolution and Community Engagement
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42049503/71da3f46dec5055d566185513ad757d4728b1315.jpg[/img]

[h2][h3]Greetings, RTE Worlds Community![/h3][/h2]

It's been a while since our last Steam update, and I wanted to take a moment to connect with you all and share the exciting developments happening in the world of RTE Worlds. While I might not regularly post on Steam, the heart of our community beats strong in our Discord channel. If you haven't joined yet, I highly encourage you to jump in and be part of the conversation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42049503/b285dd1d2acf63432623dca1096abd1b5fefc110.jpg[/img]

[h3]Discord: Your Hub for RTE Worlds Updates[/h3]

Our Discord community has been buzzing with activity, and I've been regularly sharing exclusive updates, screenshots, and insights into the development process. It's the perfect place to get a sneak peek at what's happening behind the scenes. Join us to connect with fellow survivors, share your thoughts, and stay up-to-date on all things RTE Worlds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42049503/1236b3bbd22cb14a74d0d8ecaa5eb27803e60e28.jpg[/img]

[h3]RTE Worlds: A Rapid Evolution[/h3]

[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42049503/86465c6e08545429a0e88d8d6a1769e03ad657d6.jpg[/img]
[*] New Mutants and Monsters: Brace yourselves for encounters with terrifying new mutants and monsters lurking in the shadows. Each one poses unique challenges, adding an extra layer of excitement to your survival journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42049503/d307ec5845a6d95b257403ea62b725dda2355ff3.jpg[/img]

[*] Expansive Locations: Explore fresh, immersive locations filled with valuable loot. From abandoned facilities to overgrown forests, there's always something new to discover in the ever-evolving world of RTE Worlds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42049503/3acfb787a74e64eaca10385df7c19e763c441bc0.jpg[/img]

[*] Tutorial Quest: For our newer survivors, we've introduced a comprehensive tutorial quest to guide you through the basics of survival. It's the perfect way to get acclimated to the dangers that await.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42049503/24b59b42cc5647f92118ab2feeb7c383f9d48bf9.jpg[/img]

[*] Main Game Quest - Missile Silo Repair: Embark on a thrilling quest to repair the missile silos scattered across the landscape. The fate of the world rests in your hands, and only you can ensure its survival.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42049503/17d37370dc7a02340e565dd5ec4fb3a8cd35dc56.jpg[/img]

[*] New Items and Building Tiers: Elevate your survival game with a range of new items, including a brand-new building tier. Craft comfortable chairs to sit and relax beside a warm fireplace, lay down rugs, hang paintings, and add personal touches to your home base.



[*] Bug Squashing and Balancing: Thanks to the valuable feedback from our founders, we've been hard at work squashing bugs and fine-tuning the game's balance. Your input is invaluable, and together, we're making RTE Worlds the best it can be.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42049503/65556b9db3b1078f109b92b141944394e7685442.jpg[/img]

[h2]Meet Freeda and Captain Pike in RTE Worlds![/h2]
[h3]Freeda: Your Link to the Civilian Community[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42049503/d6a8f79a3662c139e12185b67eba08715230e229.jpg[/img]

Freeda, a resourceful and compassionate individual, serves as a crucial connection between survivors like you and the scattered civilian communities. With her wealth of knowledge about the world before it changed, Freeda provides valuable insights and quests that delve into the mysteries of RTE Worlds.

As you navigate the challenges of survival, Freeda will guide you towards understanding the needs and concerns of the civilian population. Forge alliances, trade resources, and uncover hidden stories as you build a thriving community amidst the chaos.

[h3]Captain Pike: Commander of the Armed Military Defense Force[/h3]
On the other end of the spectrum, we have Captain Pike, a seasoned leader at the helm of the armed military defense force. Charged with maintaining order and protecting the remnants of society, Captain Pike brings a disciplined and strategic approach to the table.

Engage with Captain Pike to undertake military-oriented quests, fortify your base against external threats, and harness the power of organized defense. As you prove your mettle, you may find yourself in the midst of large-scale conflicts that shape the fate of RTE Worlds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42049503/74b947a04e28e675142099dcd7809720b97363b5.jpg[/img]

[h2]Dynamic Interactions and Quests[/h2]

The addition of Freeda and Captain Pike introduces a dynamic layer to the gameplay, offering diverse questlines that cater to both diplomatic and militaristic approaches. The choices you make will influence the narrative, affecting the relationships with both civilian communities and the military defense force.

Engage in thought-provoking conversations, make impactful decisions, and witness the consequences as the world of RTE Worlds responds to your actions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42049503/a92960a4fbfb784878a44c7c1df9799659e55d6a.jpg[/img]

[h2]What's Next? More Dev Blogs Coming Soon![/h2]

This is just the beginning of the exciting journey we're embarking on with RTE Worlds. I'm committed to keeping you in the loop, and you can expect more frequent dev blogs on Steam in the coming weeks. Your passion and dedication drive the development, and I can't wait to share more with you soon.

Thank you for being part of the RTE Worlds community. Your support means the world to us.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42049503/939e0eba6fe0ef8289bcbcd9b274cd584c2f8366.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42049503/1a5911f7fd538b5ba71c09c6f07e5cc3d2366172.jpg[/img]
[h1]RTE WORLDS Development log 2[/h1]

[h2]Current pre_alpha version : 10[/h2]

[h3]Hello survivors!

Here is a brief summary of what has been implemented in RTE words this month;

RTE worlds difficulty is based on distance from camp hope, the further you venture out the tougher the enemies will be and the greater the reward. I am planing to add more camps for trading and will act as safe zones for players as they venture away from camp hope. each camp will have a different economy, some camps will have cheap food items, some will have cheap crafting items, its on the player to find what each camp needs and profit from it.

I added a lot of new Items, Skills, weapons and firearms. I also added more blood and gore to the combat system to improve the feel of the hits [/h3]

[h3]I added 2 new enemies with unique play styles and the ability to block incoming hit as well as inflict special states, like being pinned down by a spider web, planing and timing attacks is key to survival when encountering them. [/h3]

notes.title: Dev-LOG 1
notes.notes:
[h1]Development log 1[/h1]

[h2]Current pre_alpha version : 9.3[/h2]

[h3]Hello survivors!

I am starting a new Dev-Log to keep you updated on the current state of RTE Worlds.

Here is a brief summary of what has been implemented in RTE words [/h3]

[h2]Character [/h2]
[h3]The character can climb almost any surface in the game and can jump from any height using the glider.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42049503/ac0c08c968e7e80cfd9a65250cb6f38f06a50189.jpg[/img]

[h2]World generator [/h2]

[h3]I have implemented several systems to generate the world;
Seed presets, random seeds, and the ability to tweak the random seed to fit you taste [/h3]

[h2]Equipment [/h2]

[h3]I have just implemented the shoulder character slot, and 35 new shoulder armors, which you can buy from the armor smith[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42049503/6a914839e37bdc46585cbadde82b4872cb39a784.png[/img]

[h2]Building system [/h2]

[h3]I have added the ability to rotate any building piece even after it is installed.
I have also added the stone bridge piece on which you can snap foundations and build structures
You can also upgrade basic walls and other pieces directly to the desired tier (if you have it unlocked) without going through all the lower tiers.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42049503/a6f2406e4b7e6e4cf3e84ff25e70e79f5b85666e.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42049503/474c1764c9867fdefbecb5e5acad77dba7744e1d.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42049503/d6a6f15347e89be1cb4ed93b46fe2529671f806c.jpg[/img]
Mortar station

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42049503/dd55fcab904b9089a1f12ecaf28244d3b2e7a79c.jpg[/img]
Research station

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42049503/e4c57bd8ec4608c7453877e45f0b959833d320bc.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42049503/341585d075d7d7badcee02b6feb275100fa07c8f.jpg[/img]

[h2]Difficulty level [/h2]

[h3]The difficulty level of RTE Worlds is based on the distance from camp hope, the further away you are from camp hope the harder it will become, the better the xp and the loot will become, be careful not to venture further than you can handle.[/h3]

[h3]I am also excited to show you the things I am currently working on

The mega hordes are hordes of 50 to 300 infected that will get attracted by your base and will roam around your base. They will not destroy your base.
They spawn from large terraforming crystals that you need to destroy as soon as possible.[/h3]
